# Project instructions

This repository is a lightweight personal/static website. Keep the codebase simple, portable, and easy to maintain unless the project later introduces a build system or framework.

- Prefer static, dependency-light changes: semantic HTML, simple CSS, and minimal JavaScript.
- Do not introduce frameworks, package managers, or build tooling without a clear need and a repo-wide convention.
- Keep page structure accessible and performant: use semantic headings, descriptive link text, alt text for images, and no unnecessary animations or scripts.
- Maintain the current repo conventions: small files, readable markup, and clear naming.
- If you add a page or asset, ensure it fits the existing site structure and update navigation or links when appropriate.
- Treat the README as a minimal project summary; keep it accurate when meaningful repo changes are made.
- Validate changes with the lightest possible check available for this repo. There is no existing test/build pipeline yet, so prefer local rendering checks or simple static verification over adding new tooling.
- Keep changes focused and avoid unrelated refactors or dependency churn.
